vb_textbox.text: TO BE  ON TOP OF THIS GAME, THIS IS THE STRATEGY. THERE ARE TWO DIFFERENT COLORED GNOMES, THESE GNOMES LEADS TO BASKETS WHICH MUSHROOMS ARE GATHERED FROM, WITHIN THE GAME THE GNOMES THAT LEADS TO THE RED BASKET ARE RED, PINK, PURPLE AND BROWN.  WHILES THE GNOMES THAT LEADS TO YELLOW BASKET ARE YELLOW, ORANGE, BLUE AND GREEN. TO EARN THE  MOST POINTS IN THIS GAME IS TO SWITCH BETWEEN THE TWO COLORED BASKET.
